identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of the Anti-PD1 Antibody PDR001, in Combination With Dabrafenib and Trametinib in Advanced Melanoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Phase III Study Comparing the Combination of PDR001, Dabrafenib and Trametinib Versus Placebo, Dabrafenib and Trametinib in Previously Untreated Patients With Unresectable or Metastatic BRAF V600 Mutant Melanoma

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Part 1 and Part 2 are open- label. Part 3 is double-blind and randomized.

armGroups.label: Part 1: Safety run-in Cohort
armGroups.description: In Part 1, participants are treated at different dose levels to determine the recommended Phase 3 regimen of spartalizumab in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib. The starting dose of spartalizumab is 400 mg Q4W in combination with the approved dose of dabrafenib (150 mg BID) and trametinib (2 mg QD).

armGroups.label: Part 2: Biomarker cohort
armGroups.description: In Part 2, participants are treated with spartalizumab 400 mg Q4W in combination with the approved dose of dabrafenib (150 mg BID) and trametinib (2 mg QD).

armGroups.label: Part 3- Arm 1: Spartalizumab in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib
armGroups.description: In Part 3, participants are randomized to receive spartalizumab at the RP3R identified in Part 1 (400 mg Q4W) in combination with approved dose of dabrafenib (150 mg BID) and trametinib (2 mg QD)

armGroups.label: Part 3- Arm 2: Placebo in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib
armGroups.description: In Part 3, participants are randomized to receive matching placebo in combination with the approved dose of dabrafenib (150 mg BID) and trametinib (2 mg QD)

interventions.name: Spartalizumab
interventions.description: Spartalizumab powder for solution is used in Part 1 and Part 2, and as concentrate for solution for infusion for Part 3. Spartalizumab is administered via intravenous infusion over 30 minutes once every 4 weeks
armGroupLabels: Part 3- Arm 1: Spartalizumab in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo is administered via intravenous infusion over 30 minutes once every 4 weeks
armGroupLabels: Part 3- Arm 2: Placebo in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib

interventions.name: Dabrafenib
interventions.description: Dabrafenib 150 mg capsules BID is administered orally for Days 1-28 of a 28-day cycle, in fasting conditions.
armGroupLabels: Part 3- Arm 1: Spartalizumab in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib
Part 3- Arm 2: Placebo in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib

interventions.name: Trametinib
interventions.description: Trametinib 2 mg tablets QD is administered orally for Days 1-28 of a 28-day cycle, in fasting conditions
armGroupLabels: Part 3- Arm 1: Spartalizumab in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib
Part 3- Arm 2: Placebo in combination with dabrafenib and trametinib
